payload.rationale: The document is a sprint retro that directly maps to the existing Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322 source and its witness-depth leaves: the Zephyr integration unlock position, the 23-point velocity observation, and the thesis-proven claim. I expanded the three narratives that frame these claims — ZeroEffortCapture (the sprint's operating thesis), AntiSlackPositioning (the product positioning the widget validates), and DecisionsEvaporate/DecisionCaptureAtConsensus (the foundational problem the widget solves). I also surfaced adjacent positions from the same retro (context preservation next sprint, pricing tier change, webhook architecture) and the earlier product-vision positions (product category, target market, $12 pricing) so the passes can bind the retro's claims to their prior framing and detect supersession. Style observations (direct-quote and metric-anchor) are included so the passes can match the document's register. No areas were deliberately excluded — the graph is small and every node plausibly overlaps this document.
